description: This file defines the ProjectAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, providing REST API endpoints for managing Project entities, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting projects. It utilizes various traits, models, validators, and annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: ProjectAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class providing CRUD operations for Project entities within the time tracking module, with methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting projects, including validation and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list combined project data with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' method, ensuring query parameters are valid.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project based on input data.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Sets project properties from request parameters, including customer ID, name, description, and admins.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a project.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common validation rules for project creation and update requests.

methods.name: getProjectCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates and returns an option object for unique project name validation within a customer context.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove multiple projects, with checks for existing timesheet items.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific project by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single project.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing project, replacing admin list and other properties.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a project, considering unique name constraints.
